summary: Write and run final analysis: K=25 pilot screen, default RF, nested screen-in-folds CV
reasoning: step-41/42 verified seed robustness of the fixed procedure: pilot cv 0.7252-0.7563 across 5 fold seeds (>= 0.70 floor with margin), holdout 0.7300-0.7320 across 3 tree seeds (>= 0.71 floor with margin). K=25 fixed is justified by pilot-only evidence (consistent CV preference over alternatives in four independent grid scans); default tree shape because pilot tuning gains are <= 0.005 (noise) and full-grown trees transfer best to the 400-row final fit. Expect seed-0 metrics: cv_auc ~0.725, holdout_auc ~0.731, gap ~-0.006, n_features=25 — passing all four route conditions.
